intro.sr: Paketi nemaju samostalnu naplatu na sajtu - administrator ručno dodeljuje paket klijentu, a klijent zatim iz njega troši seanse kroz običan tok zakazivanja, bez ikakve doplate. Snimljeno na telefonu (390x844).
intro.en: Packages have no self-checkout - an admin manually assigns one to a customer, who then spends sessions from it through the ordinary booking flow, at no extra charge. Recorded on a phone (390x844).
